_comment: Title pool v3 — tuned to YouTube's indexing/suggestion rules: the exact search phrase '{genre} Mix' is front-loaded right after the track name (search+suggested match on the first ~40 chars), each formula stays under ~70 chars before the auto-appended [XX Min] tail, ONE emoji max, no serial numbering (mass-produced signature), hooks are proven winners (NEED 1822, Late Night 660, DIFFERENT 378, LOUD, Everyone's Playing 239, Broke My Speakers 178). Placeholders: TRACKNAME, {genre}, {genre_hashtag}. One per upload, non-repeating within TITLE_HISTORY_WINDOW.
templates: TRACKNAME 🔥 {genre} Mix You NEED Right Now | {genre_hashtag}
